scene: Martin & Moyce: an a x depth x 2a cell column against the x_lo wall of a 5a x depth x (2a + 10) cell open tank, released from rest at t = 0 (no gate)

particle_radius.meaning: r; particles start on a cubic lattice of spacing 2r, one per (2r)^3 cell

spacing.meaning: 2r: rest particle distance (lattice spacing), the 'particle size' of most engines

support_radius.meaning: h = 4 r = 2 x spacing: kernel cutoff, W = 0 at distance >= h (SPlisHSPlasH convention; Monaghan's smoothing length of this spline is h / 2)

particle_mass.meaning: m = rho0 / S, S = 124996558 m^-3 the kernel sum over the rest lattice (self included): an interior lattice particle has rho = rho0 exactly. rho0 (2r)^3 = 8e-06 kg is 2.75e-05 lighter (relative)

viscosity_model.meaning: Alloy's choice for mu <= 1e-2 Pa s: XSPH velocity smoothing v_i += c sum_j (m_j / rho_j) (v_j - v_i) W_ij after gravity; no other viscous force

pressure_solver.meaning: divergence-free SPH (Bender & Koschier 2017): divergence solve, then constant-density solve every step; unilateral (no tension); cg iterations (projected preconditioned CG)

max_density_error.meaning: mean max(rho - rho0, 0) / rho0 per world after the density solve (and the per-particle max <= 10 x this)

max_divergence_error.meaning: mean max(Drho/Dt, 0) dt / rho0 per world

iterations.meaning: min / max pressure iterations per solve

boundary.meaning: walls and bodies enter the density as SDF half-space volumes (tube map with order-1 curvature, Koschier & Bender 2017 family); free-slip walls, no wall viscosity

time_step.meaning: fixed law dt, 1 substep (no CFL adaptation in law runs)

initial_pressure.meaning: SolverDFSPH.prime solves the hydrostatic pressure as the solver's warm start before step 1; positions and velocities stay as packed (an engine starts from rest; its own pressure initialisation, if any, is a setting to record)

particles.note: place exactly these (Alloy's float32 values, pack order), at rest; never resample. They are 2r-lattice cell centres (i + 1/2) 2r from the tank's inner corner, minus the cells under the box (archimedes); offsets are float32 rounding only

tank.note: static boxes (float32 model values), SDF boundaries; they tile the solid without overlap. The liquid sees only these walls (and the box); there is no gate and no ground plane

export.particle_q: [T, W, P, 3] float32: liquid particle positions [m], world frame, every frame (frame k = physics step k x record_every; frame 0 = the packed state)
export.metric: ritter_excess (twin front_kernel): front x = max x of the liquid with z < 4 r, plus r; Z = x / a, T = t sqrt(2 g / a); error = max(0, max over T <= 3 of Z - (1 + 2 T))

export_common: npz per README contract: meta (dt, record_every, settings incl. the SPH parameter mapping), t [T]; particle_frame [Tp] int (indices into t) when particle_q holds only some frames
